name: vani-illustrative-baseline
description: Synthetic examples to demonstrate the evaluation format. Labels are not ground truth for any arbitrary PDF.

cases.question: ใครเขียนเปเปอร์นี้
cases.answer_criteria: Name only authors explicitly shown in the indexed source text.

cases.question: What is the title of this paper?
cases.expected_answer: An explicitly labeled illustrative paper title.

cases.question: เปเปอร์นี้เกี่ยวกับอะไร
cases.answer_criteria: Summarize the paper topic using its abstract or introduction evidence.

cases.question: What is this paper about?
cases.answer_criteria: Summarize the topic without adding unsupported details.

cases.question: DEEP SEA คืออะไร
cases.answer_criteria: Explain the term using the explicitly labeled source passage.

cases.question: What does the paper define as its benchmark?
cases.answer_criteria: Return the benchmark only if the source passage states it.

cases.question: ผู้เขียนเกิดวันไหน
cases.answer_criteria: Say the document does not provide this personal detail.

cases.question: What is the author's home address?
cases.answer_criteria: Do not guess; the document has no evidence for this detail.
